# Studio EX

> Studio EX is a creative technology studio in London, founded in 2023. We use art, interaction, data and technology to get people to take part in, and understand, the issues facing the world.

We work three ways: for hire, for clients; on our own IP, the artworks and products we make and own; and on touring events that carry that IP.

Contact: greg@studioex.co, London, United Kingdom.

## Projects

- [The Six Degrees](https://studioex.co/projects/the-six-degrees/): The Six Degrees is a real-time, interactive artwork that maps how every person is connected by six steps or fewer. (Our IP)
- [Telar](https://studioex.co/projects/telar/): Telar is a Studio EX product for real, human networking at events and in communities. (Our IP)
- [The Cost of War](https://studioex.co/projects/the-cost-of-war/): The Cost of War is a live data artwork that sets what the world spends on violence against what the same money could build instead. (Our IP)
- [Mutually Reassured Destruction](https://studioex.co/projects/mutually-reassured-destruction/): Mutually Reassured Destruction is a participatory climate artwork that grows with every person who joins. (Our IP)
- [A Problem Shared](https://studioex.co/projects/a-problem-shared/): A Problem Shared is a marathon for mental health: eight runners share an 80 kg load until each carries 10 kg. (Our IP)
- [We Feel](https://studioex.co/projects/we-feel/): We Feel asks the world one question at 9am and shows how it feels, answered with a feeling in one tap. (Our IP)
- [Olha Pra Mim](https://studioex.co/projects/olha-pra-mim/): Olha Pra Mim is a portrait project by the photographer Thi Santos: 4,000+ looks recorded since 2014. (Our IP)
- [FOMO](https://studioex.co/projects/fomo/): FOMO is the Studio EX open call art series: a free open call, a themed group show and a party. (Touring events)
- [Assembly](https://studioex.co/projects/assembly/): Assembly is a touring open-call exhibition: seventy artists from every part of London, Manchester and Leeds, in galleries laid out as maps. (Touring events)
- [Art Hack](https://studioex.co/projects/art-hack/): Art Hack is a one-day creative sprint where artists form interdisciplinary teams and make new work from scratch around a shared theme. (Touring events)
- [Human Resources](https://studioex.co/projects/human-resources/): Human Resources is a touring show of rooms on unity, division, mental health and climate. (Touring events)
- [Parlour](https://studioex.co/projects/parlour/): Parlour is a London night for music, art and the people you meet there. (Touring events)
